sections.title: Project overview
sections.content: A bakery wants a new website that lets customers order cakes online.

sections.title: Key details
sections.content: Deliverables: menu page, order form, contact page. Deadline: before the holiday season. Budget: around $3,000. Constraint: the look should be modern but also traditional.

sections.title: Gaps and risks
sections.content: The launch date is not concrete, the desired style is ambiguous, and online ordering may imply payment handling that the brief does not cover. The target audience is not stated.

sections.title: Questions to ask
sections.content: What is the exact launch date? Which example websites show the desired look? Should customers pay online or only send orders?

response_json.summary: The brief is workable but not ready to start: confirm the exact launch date first, then the style direction and whether payments are online.
